plugins.name: Store Extras
plugins.shortDescription: Adds Steam user rating, Metacritic score, banners and trailers, with GOG as fallback.
plugins.description:
Metadata provider that fills the fields other providers leave empty: user rating (Steam reviews, SteamSpy fallback), critic rating (Metacritic via Steam), header/banner images (Steam library hero, then header) and up to four trailers. GOG is used when Steam does not know a title or a field is missing.

Put it at the top of the metadata priority list; it only returns rating, banner and trailer fields, so other providers keep supplying everything else.
